sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the prayer sought for in this writ petition has become infructuous.
Hence, he seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this petition and also made an endorsement to that effect.
2. In view of the endorsement made by the learned counsel for the petitioner, this writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
